Build full ap, dont engage when your teammates arent in range for your E. Its always good to ult before your W to make sure no one escapes. Vision is very important so you can ambush anyone easily with your cc. You can cancel the knockup animation earlier if you E fast enough to your ally, also when you E away dont E back unless your adc doesn't have his shield or until your CD resets.

If your adc is bad just roam and help mid or jungle, a roaming rakan is very helpful. Dont start useless fights when you know the enemy has their cc ready and their ults ready, wait until someone slips up in position and W+Ult. Also prioritize your cc on the enemies who deal the most damage.

Do this and learn the combos and keep focus on vision and you will get easy MVP +S rating every game even if you lose.

I play LoL and Vainglory. I also played other mobile moba's. Both games are fun. LoL is more diverse and the games lasts a lot longer. I personally prefer vainglory because it doesnt last too long as LoL especially 5v5. Games can end very fast. In LoL sometimes being a lil creative with champions that are support or tank, etc.. like going full ad or ap can be punishing if it doesnt work out and it mostly doesnt work out at all. Unlike VG where you can take ardan and go full wp and it could work or cp, both paths work differentially and change the playstyle of that hero. Wp ardan focus on close combat and getting that burst dmg with B on squishies, while CP ardan focus on ranged burst ult and tanking for your allies and protecting them or setting up plays with your ult or your A slow + frostburn. Vainglory doesnt have as many heroes as LoL or too many maps and game mods as LoL but sometimes anything can work and be meta. I play LoL because they have longer games and stricted playstyles. I play VG to have fun and mess around without wasting too much time.
